preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of caves n must be between 3 and 1000, and the number of tunnels m must be between n and the minimum of (n * (n - 1)) // 2 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) and all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All values a_i and b_i must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in tunnels)
preconditions.description: All cave indices u_i and v_i in the tunnels must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest possible power the hero must start with to beat all monsters.
